description: Azure OpenAI chat completion through the OpenAI SDK, one turn, traced by OpenInference through cetra's SDK.
notes: The Azure client targets https://capture.openai.azure.com, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). The request names the deployment my-gpt4o-deployment, and the response names the base model gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, which OpenInference writes as llm.model_name. The instrumentor writes llm.provider azure, and cetra's runtime stamps server.address capture.openai.azure.com (D-IN-18), so the provider is azure.ai.openai (D-IN-2). Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.
